question: According to FIGO 2023 staging for endometrial cancer, Stage IA disease is defined by tumour confined to the endometrium with less than 50% myometrial invasion.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect — this statement is true. FIGO 2023 Stage IA: tumour confined to the uterus, <50% myometrial invasion. Stage IB: tumour confined to uterus, ≥50% myometrial invasion. Remember: endometrial cancer uses FIGO 2023, while cervical cancer uses FIGO 2018.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. FIGO 2023 Stage IA = endometrial cancer confined to the uterus with <50% myometrial invasion. Note: FIGO 2023 is the current system for endometrial cancer — it is NOT the same as FIGO 2018, which applies to cervical cancer.
